title: Cookie Policy
bodyHtml:
What Are Cookies

Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They allow the site to remember information about your visit — like whether you're logged in — across page loads and sessions.

Cookies We Use

HomeWODRx uses Google Analytics to understand how the site is used: which pages people visit, how they found the site and roughly where they are. We don't use advertising cookies, and advertising features in Google Analytics are turned off.

  • Analytics cookies (_ga, _ga_*), set by Google Analytics. They tell visits apart with a random identifier and last up to two years. In the EEA, UK and Switzerland they are only set if you choose Accept in the cookie banner.
  • Essential cookie — a login cookie for the site's administrator only. Visitors don't receive it.

Your cookie choice and your light or dark display choice are saved in your own browser's storage and never sent to us. We also count visits ourselves without cookies (see the Privacy Policy). Embedded YouTube videos use YouTube's privacy-enhanced mode and only load when you press play; once playing, YouTube's own policies apply.

Controlling Cookies

You can change your choice at any time with Cookie choices at the bottom of every page; choosing Decline also removes the Google Analytics cookies. You can also view and delete cookies in your browser settings, or install Google's Google Analytics opt-out add-on. Blocking cookies doesn't change how the site works for you.

Updates to This Policy

We may update this Cookie Policy as the site evolves and new technologies are introduced. The date at the top of this page reflects the most recent revision.
